name: Posol Dobroy Voli
source:
The story is told from the perspective of an American girl named Samantha Smith, before she visits the Soviet state. The USSR of the eighties invites the little activist to visit in response to her touching letter, where perfectly meaningful adult questions are voiced in childlike words.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3016843582]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这个故事是从一个名叫萨曼莎·史密斯的美国女孩在访问苏联之前的角度讲述的。八十年代的苏联邀请这位小活动家来访，以回应她感人的信，信中用孩子般的语言提出了完全有意义的成人问题。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3016843582]Steam[/url]]
